responsibility: This file implements the machinery for applying diagnostic fix-it hints to source text and computing the resulting edited contents or unified diff output. It tracks edits per file and per line, adjusts subsequent fix-it coordinates to account for earlier insertions/replacements/removals, supports multi-line changes through predecessor added lines, and can render updated file contents or patch hunks. It is the execution engine behind GCC's fix-it application and diff generation, with selftests for edge cases and invalid edits.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete machinery behind edit_context, including per-file and per-line edit tracking, fix-it application, content rewriting, diff generation, and selftests. The header only exposes the edit_context API and forward declarations.
